title: 第25章 抢劫天星宗第26章 魅魔林霆
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第25章抢劫天星宗云洛拿出玉简查看消息。
这几日，王三每隔几个时辰便会向她汇报天星宗那些人在干什么。
他们没有金丹期弟子，因此没有像合欢宗这样分队。
而是所有人都聚在一起。
王三一个时辰前发来了消息。
说天星宗发现了一片虫草地，如今正在挖，并附上了位置，在归墟秘境的西边缘。
王三还告诉她，林霆身上有许多宝贝，他们好几次遇到偷袭，都是林霆帮着躲过去的。
云洛不觉得意外，陈家连灵根都能为他修复，多些保命的法器不算稀奇。
“大师姐。”
她抱着玉简凑到秦慕霜跟前。
“嗯？”秦慕霜正在擦拭她的灵剑。
“我们去抢东西好不好？”
秦慕霜抬头：“抢天星宗？”
“对对对，去吗？”
“去。”她收起灵剑，“正好我叫了二师妹和三师妹，我们一起。”
云洛：？
原来师姐和她想到一块去了。
她桀桀桀一笑，看她不把林霆的屁股打烂。
这几天，她们收集天材地宝的时候，也不是没有遇见过其他人。
可她们都选择了和平共处，有时遇到妖兽太多还会合作，最后按劳分配。

但天星宗嘛，打了就打了。
二人等了半个时辰，苏羡鱼和褚璃匆匆赶来。
她们甚至用上了加速符，生怕晚一步，就让林霆给跑了。
“那林霆是猪脑子吗？长老们就在外面，也敢在秘境里买凶杀人？”
褚璃觉得离谱。
云洛：“没那么聪明。”
“咱们得好好给他一个教训。”
苏羡鱼摸着下巴道。
林霆和陈家有关系，杀他肯定是不好杀，不过恶心人的办法有的是。
云洛乌溜溜的眼珠子转了转，灵机一动，低声道：
“咱们先这样……再这样……”
商量完后，四个人发出反派的笑声，全速赶往秘境西边缘。
到地方后，云洛远远看见天星宗的一行人正撅着屁股在挖灵虫草。
几个有战斗力的筑基弟子则在应付那些密密麻麻的千足蜈蚣。
这些蜈蚣大多才凝气，但数量众多，让人烦不胜烦，一不注意还会往耳朵里钻。
云洛躲在树后欣赏了一会儿众人的狼狈样，骑着拽拽先行一步出去。
正在和蜈蚣激战的古薇看到她尖叫一声。
content_en:
Chapter 25 Robbery Tianxing Zong Yunluo took out the jade slip to check the news.
In the past few days, Wang San would report to her every few hours what the people of Tianxing Sect were doing.
They do not have Jindan disciples, so they do not have separate teams like the Hehuan Sect.
But everyone comes together.
Wang San sent a message an hour ago.
It is said that the Tianxing Sect discovered a piece of Cordyceps Grass and is now digging it, and also attached the location, which is at the western edge of the Guixu Secret Realm.
Wang San also told her that Lin Ting had many treasures on him. They encountered sneak attacks several times, but Lin Ting helped them avoid them.
Yunluo was not surprised. The Chen family could even repair spiritual roots for him. It was not unusual to have more life-saving magic weapons.
"Sister."
She held the jade slip and approached Qin Mushuang.
"Huh?" Qin Mushuang was wiping her spirit sword.
"Shall we go grab something?"
Qin Mushuang raised his head: "Robbing Tianxing Sect?"
"Yes, yes, do you want to go?"
"Go." She put away the spirit sword, "I just happened to call the second junior sister and the third junior sister, let's go together."
Yunluo:?
It turned out that the senior sister and her wanted to go together.
She smiled sarcastically to see if she didn't spank Lin Ting's ass.
In the past few days, when they were collecting heavenly materials and earthly treasures, they had met other people.
But they all chose to coexist peacefully. Sometimes they would cooperate when there were too many monsters and beasts, and in the end, they would be distributed according to their work.
But Tianxing Sect, if they fight, they will fight.
The two waited for half an hour before Su Xianyu and Chu Li hurried over.
They even used the acceleration charm, fearing that if they were one step too late, Lin Ting would run away.
"Is Lin Ting a pig-headed person? The elders are outside and dare to buy and kill people in the secret realm?"
Chu Li felt outrageous.
Yunluo: "Not that smart."
"We have to teach him a lesson."
Su Xianyu touched his chin and said.
Lin Ting has a relationship with the Chen family, so it's definitely not easy to kill him, but there are plenty of disgusting ways to kill him.
Yunluo rolled his eyes, then had an idea and whispered:
"Let's do this first...and then..."
After the discussion, the four people laughed like villains and rushed to the western edge of the secret realm at full speed.
After arriving at the place, Yunluo saw a group of people from the Tianxing Sect digging for cordyceps from a distance.
A few capable foundation-building disciples were dealing with the densely packed thousand-legged centipedes.
Most of these centipedes are capable of condensing energy, but there are so many of them that they are annoying to people, and they will even burrow into the ears if they are not careful.
Yunluo hid behind a tree and admired everyone's embarrassment for a while, then rode out first.
Gu Wei, who was fighting fiercely with the centipede, screamed when she saw her.
